description: Source code for OCDM plugin implementation, including memory observation, initialization, deinitialization, and request processing.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IMemory interface to observe process memory usage, associated with a remote connection.

methods.name: MemoryObserver
methods.description: Creates a memory observer object for a given remote connection.

methods.name: OCDM::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, setting up content decryption, memory observer, and registering notifications.

methods.name: OCDM::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and terminates remote connections.

methods.name: OCDM::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: OCDM::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently empty.

methods.name: OCDM::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, returning available systems, designators, or sessions.
